study type: Cell line generation and characterization study
outcome: differentiation into cells of three embryonic germ layers
absence of Sendai viral genome at passage 25
cohort: Caesarean section scar fibroblasts obtained from a 33-year-old healthy woman.
finding: A human induced pluripotent stem cell line (MUSIi001-A) was successfully generated from caesarean section scar fibroblasts using transgene-free Sendai viral vectors and characterized to show pluripotency and genetic stability.
mod_finding: The iPSC line was generated from fibroblasts derived from a caesarean section scar.
